entries.description: A drop-in replacement for actions/deploy-pages that publishes a GitHub Pages site to GenHTTP Lambda, with traffic statistics, a request log, every deployment kept and an optional server part, without a secret.
representativeQueries: add analytics to a GitHub Pages site without a tracking script
add a backend to a GitHub Pages site
deploy a static site from GitHub Actions without a secret

entries.description: The whole documentation of the action in one text: switching a workflow, activation, inputs, outputs and how a site is served.
The platform a GenHTTP Pages site runs on: an agent adds or changes its server part - APIs, websockets, a database - with the site's dashboard link.
